episodes.synopsis: Watanuki's life changes completely when he meets Yūko for the first time. Watanuki is given a job at Yūko's shop, paying off his debt. Mokona, Maru and Moro all make their first appearance in this episode.
episodes.title: Hitsuzen

episodes.synopsis: A client seeks Yūko's aid because she has problems with her right little finger; Yūko tells her that it is happening because of a bad habit of hers. Watanuki learns more about Yūko while becoming the shop's cook. Himawari-chan and Doumeki both make their first appearance in this episode.
episodes.title: Falsehood

episodes.synopsis: Himawari-chan asks for Yūko's help to solve a series of mysterious incidents occurring at the school, involving a game called angel. Yūko meets Himawari-chan, and Watanuki is forced to work with Doumeki. Doumeki begins to learn about his true nature.
episodes.title: Angel

episodes.synopsis: Yūko decides to show Watanuki what a real Diviner can do. Watanuki learns more about Yūko's powers, while his past is explained. The important butterfly symbolism found throughout the series is also explained.
episodes.title: Divination

episodes.synopsis: Watanuki encounters an uncommon oden shop in the middle of the night, while engaging in a dangerous task with Mokona's aid. Watanuki meets the Fox family and later gives the Young Fox a Haja Arrow. The full moon brings new life to Yūko's shop.
episodes.title: Word-Chain Game

episodes.synopsis: Watanuki and Yūko pay a visit to a client who desires to abandon her addiction to computers.
episodes.title: Indulgence

episodes.synopsis: A rain sprite (Ame-warashi) seeks Yūko's help to save a friend of hers.
episodes.title: Hydrangea

episodes.synopsis: A teacher in Watanuki's school gets her hands into a dangerous item from Yūko's shop, the monkey's paw. The teacher's discovery eventually leads to her downfall and of the monkey's paw choking her.
episodes.title: Contract

episodes.synopsis: Yūko receives a Pipe Fox as payment from Ame-warashi, while another client with bad habit problems arrives at the shop.
episodes.title: Promise

episodes.synopsis: Yūko decides to arrange a ghost stories meeting with Watanuki and his friends.
episodes.title: Candlelight

episodes.synopsis: When a Zashiki-warashi accidentally steals Doumeki's soul, Watanuki has to go after her to get it back, aloof to what are her true intentions.
episodes.title: Confession

episodes.synopsis: It's summer and the gang decides to spend some days in a house by the beach. For some reason Doumeki keeps asking Watanuki to call for his help, but he can't figure out why. Unbeknownst to them, there's a ghost lurking inside. When Watanuki discovers this, will he investigate alone?
episodes.title: Summer Shadow

episodes.synopsis: Watanuki investigates a classmate of his who started to behave strangely since a pair of wings started to grow from her back.
episodes.title: Transfiguration

episodes.synopsis: Watanuki and Doumeki meet a pair of twin sisters and even go to a date with them, but Watanuki can't shake the feeling there is something strange about the older one.
episodes.title: Seal

episodes.synopsis: The situation involving the twin sisters start to get dangerous as one of them starts to bleed for apparently no reason.
episodes.title: Release

episodes.synopsis: In order to make the Pipe Fox revert to its original form, Yūko sends Watanuki to purify it in a mystical mountain, where he meets the Zashiki-warashi again.
episodes.title: Reunion

episodes.synopsis: Watanuki brings to the shop a woman with an urge to always take irrational decisions in her choices.
episodes.title: Circumstances

episodes.synopsis: Yūko receives a magic lantern, also called a "ground cherry", and asks Watanuki and Doumeki to take it to a very uncommon festival.
episodes.title: Hozuki

episodes.synopsis: Watanuki and the gang, including the Zashiki-warashi and the Ame-warashi, have an interesting snowball fight.
episodes.title: Irrational

episodes.synopsis: A desperate customer seeks Yūko's help because she is being haunted by a strange photo that she can't get rid of.
episodes.title: Compensate

episodes.synopsis: Watanuki ignores some old superstitions and put himself in trouble.
episodes.title: Nail Clippers

episodes.synopsis: Watanuki meets a beautiful woman and starts to see her every day hoping to soothe her loneliness, but somehow he starts to get sick and can't figure out the reason.
episodes.title: Temptation

episodes.synopsis: As Watanuki has more encounters with the mysterious woman, his condition worsens and Doumeki decides to intervene.
episodes.title: Choice

episodes.synopsis: Watanuki reminisces about his childhood, when he was saved by a boy who became a precious friend of his.
episodes.title: Reminiscence
